theorem forall_prime_iff_two_and_odd {P : ℕ → Prop} :
    (∀ p, p.Prime → P p) ↔ P 2 ∧ ∀ p, p.Prime → p ≠ 2 → P p := by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨h 2 prime_two, fun p hp hne ↦ h p hp⟩
  · obtain rfl | hne := eq_or_ne p 2
    · exact h.1
    · exact h.2 p hp hne

theorem induction_on' {motive : M ∗ N → Prop} (m : M ∗ N)
    (one : motive 1)
    (inl_mul : ∀ m x, motive x → motive (inl m * x))
    (inr_mul : ∀ n x, motive x → motive (inr n * x)) : motive m := by
  rcases mk_surjective m with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  induction x using FreeMonoid.inductionOn' with
  | one => simpa using one

    cases x with

    | inr n => simpa using inr_mul n _ ih

theorem squarefree_iff_prime_sq_not_dvd {n : ℤ} :
    Squarefree n ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ¬ (p : ℤ) ^ 2 ∣ n := by
  have bridge : ∀ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) ^ 2 ∣ n ↔ p * p ∣ n.natAbs := by
    intro p
    rw [show ((p : ℤ) ^ 2) = ((p * p : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, Int.natCast_dvd]
  rw [← Int.squarefree_natAbs, Nat.squarefree_iff_prime_squarefree]
  exact
    ⟨fun h p hp hdvd => h p hp ((bridge p).mp hdvd),
      fun h x hx hdvd => h x hx ((bridge x).mpr hdvd)⟩
